name: find-an-ndis-provider
description: Find Australian NDIS providers by service and location using public NDIS Provider Review listings and citation links.

interface.longDescription: Search the public Australian NDIS Provider Review directory for registered providers by support category and location. Compare linked public profiles with available contact details, registration status and reviews. This is an independent provider directory, not affiliated with the NDIA or NDIS Commission. Categories can be broad; confirm service fit, location coverage, prices, vacancies and current registration directly with providers. This read-only plugin cannot book services, send enquiries, assess NDIS eligibility or provide medical advice.
defaultPrompt: Find registered NDIS therapy providers in Melbourne, VIC.
Find NDIS support coordinators in Sydney, NSW.
Find NDIS personal care providers in Brisbane, QLD accepting new participants.

positive.prompt: Find registered NDIS therapy providers in Melbourne, VIC.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover categories; search therapy category 29, Melbourne, VIC, registered providers. Cite listings and explain broad therapy scope.

positive.prompt: I need daily personal care in Brisbane, Queensland. Which providers can I compare?
positive.expected_behavior: Search personal-care category 5 in Brisbane, QLD. Provide comparison options without unsupported quality rankings or vacancies.

positive.prompt: Find NDIS support coordinators in Sydney, NSW.
positive.expected_behavior: Use support-coordination category 34 in Sydney, NSW, rather than plan management. Cite provider listings.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first provider and how I can contact them.
positive.expected_behavior: After the Melbourne therapy search, fetch returned provider ID 101-physio. Show only returned public contact details and the source profile.

positive.description: Preserve filters on the next page
positive.prompt: Show me the next page of those results.
positive.expected_behavior: After the Melbourne therapy search and profile follow-up, preserve category 29, Melbourne, VIC and registered=1; request page 2.

negative.prompt: Book a provider for tomorrow and email them my plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not book or email. Explain the read-only limits and offer public contacts or help drafting a request.

negative.prompt: Tell me my NDIS eligibility and diagnose my condition.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use provider-directory tools to infer a diagnosis or funding eligibility. Explain the plugin limits.

negative.prompt: Find a disability provider in London, England.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the Australian scope. Do not substitute an Australian location or claim UK provider results from the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read-only Australian NDIS category discovery, provider search, and public profile/contact lookup. Five positive and three negative cases evaluated in ChatGPT Work on the web against the production MCP endpoint.
